I've been using a smart lock at my front door for about five to six years now, and I've tried quite a few models along the way. For most users, the ULTRALOQ Bolt Fingerprint is a solid choice — it supports Apple Home, has built-in Wi-Fi, and offers a comprehensive set of unlocking methods. Whether you prefer using your fingerprint or a simple PIN code, it basically has you covered.

HomeKit Weekly is a series dedicated to smart home accessories, automation tips, and everything related to the Apple smart home framework.

Supports Apple Home, but no Home Key

ULTRALOQ positions the Bolt Fingerprint as the first smart lock with full Apple Home integration, and it's precisely this integration that drew me in. Honestly, I still miss Touch ID on my iPhone to this day. You can lock or unlock the door through the Home app or Siri, and if you have a HomePod or Apple TV serving as a home hub, the experience is just like any other Apple Home accessory — you can add it to automation scenes, control it remotely, and it fully supports various scenarios and automation workflows.

However, for me, there's still one feature missing: Home Key. Being able to unlock the door with just a tap of your iPhone or Apple Watch — that's the real upgrade. Although it's only missing this one thing, it's not exactly a deal-breaker.

I hope ULTRALOQ will consider adding this feature in their next-generation model, because with Home Key, this lock could go from "good" to "nearly perfect." At the same time, the lock also supports Amazon Alexa, Google Home, SmartThings, and IFTTT — so no matter which smart home platform you prefer, or even if you want to switch later on, it offers great flexibility. It uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi rather than Bluetooth, which means you can do basic remote control through its app without needing an additional bridge.

Unlocking methods galore

The Bolt Fingerprint offers more unlocking methods than you can count. The fingerprint reader can store up to 50 fingerprints and 50 codes, and you can unlock using the phone app, auto-unlock when you approach the door, or via voice control through Siri, Alexa, or Google Assistant. It also comes with two physical keys, so you won't be completely locked out even if the battery dies. For me, a smart lock without physical keys as a backup is completely unacceptable.

You can also set up to 50 custom codes, and issue one-time or time-limited codes to friends, visitors, or your cleaning lady, among others. If you rent out property, this feature alone is well worth the price.

There's also a "Lockout Mode" that temporarily disables all electronic unlocking methods, including codes and app unlocking, providing extra security for those on extended trips away from home, so the house stays safer when it's empty. Personally, I don't see these features as must-haves for a smart lock, but having them certainly doesn't hurt.

Installation and Adding to Apple Home

Over the past few years, I've installed more smart locks than I can count, so I'm quite experienced by now. As long as I have the tools, I usually get it done in about ten minutes. Assuming you're replacing an existing modern deadbolt, the installation process doesn't require any wiring or drilling into the wall. A Phillips screwdriver is all you need, and remember to replace the strike plate on the door frame as well.

Once the lock is added to your Apple Home setup and assigned to a room, you can control it through the Home app or add it to automations and scenes — triggering multiple actions at once, such as having the lights turn on immediately when the front door is unlocked.

ULTRALOQ Bolt Fingerprint Overall Review

Overall, if you don't need Home Key support, the ULTRALOQ Bolt Fingerprint is a reliable choice. Fingerprint unlocking will most likely become your most frequently used method on a daily basis. The installation process is also very straightforward. I'm currently using this lock at my office door because there are always laptops sitting around waiting to be shipped out, and I want an extra layer of security. The auto-unlock feature when approaching the door is genuinely fantastic, and you can always see who's come and gone. Fingerprint unlocking gives me the same feeling I used to get with Touch ID.

You can purchase the Bolt Fingerprint directly from Amazon or the ULTRALOQ official website.
